card.line: Tarsus was the chief city of Cilicia, known for its schools and trade. It was the hometown of Saul, who became the apostle Paul.

moments.title: Saul sent to Tarsus
moments.text: Saul debated with Greek-speaking Jews in Jerusalem, and they tried to kill him. When the brothers learned of this, they sent him off to Tarsus.

moments.title: Barnabas looks for Saul
moments.text: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul. When he found him, he brought him back to Antioch, and they taught large numbers of people there for a year.
